contents: Right after liberation, September 1945. Columns of US troops march down a Seoul boulevard lined with Korean onlookers in white summer clothes and hats, then dense crowds fill the streets. An American flag is raised over a building, and a crowd gathers in a plaza. Shop fronts and office buildings carry hand-made 'WELCOME ALLIES!' and 'Welcome to the Allied Forces' banners in English and Korean/Chinese. Silent.
